visual enhancers.textures: Keep it clean and flat to maximize legibility and reduce visual noise for warehouse workers.

component usage.upload_zone: Massive drag & drop area. Dashed border (border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300), very light blue background on drag over. Large Lucide UploadCloud icon.
component usage.buttons: Rounded-lg. High contrast. Large tap targets.
component usage.stats_cards: Bento-style grid. Flat surface, subtle border, large numbers, clear labels.
component usage.tables: Dense rows for Review list and History. Alternating row colors (bg-white / bg-slate-50) for easy scanning. Sticky headers.
component usage.inputs: Clear borders, focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500), light background.
component usage.badges: Use status colors for identifying qualities or review reasons.

layouts.header: flex items-center justify-between py-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-50 px-4 md:px-8
layouts.section: bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm

motion.focus: transition-shadow duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Use dark slate for text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-live regions for processing status updates. aria-labels on icon-only buttons.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid to all interactive elements, e.g., 'upload-zone', 'organize-button', 'download-button', 'review-select-brand', 'user-name-input'.

media: Not applicable. Keep interface minimal and focused on text and data.
instructions_to_main_agent: Add 'Manrope' and 'IBM Plex Sans' fonts from Google Fonts to index.html.
Implement routing for 3 main views: 'Início', 'Histórico', and 'Configurações'.
Create a persistent top navigation bar with the app title, navigation links, and an optional 'Seu nome' input field to track user actions.

Home View: Implement a large drag & drop file upload zone. Below it, an 'ORGANIZAR ETIQUETAS' button. Show loading state. After processing, display a results bento grid (total pages, identified, classified, to review, percentage).
Review Section: If labels are not identified, show a list below results with the reason and Shadcn Select dropdowns for Manual Correction (Quality, Color, Brand, Size).
Add a 'BAIXAR PDF ORGANIZADO' button after review.
History View: A data table showing file name, user name, date/time, pages processed, classified, and reviewed.
Settings View: Use vertical tabs to switch between Brands, Colors, Qualities, and Size Rules. Implement basic CRUD interfaces for each.
Use Shadcn UI components: Card, Button, Input, Select, Table, Badge, Tabs.
Ensure responsive layout but focus primarily on desktop/tablet as it's a warehouse tool.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs; make the tool look premium but highly functional.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not center align the app container. Text should be left-aligned for readability.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-md) for sticky headers, never fully transparent over content.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
